answer: Re-attestations are stored in lantern and gale lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 8 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the quartz graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 992 impostors cost 359 times the honest price and take 3 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
